lines.zh: 我走起来很轻，像一团面。
lines.en: I move lightly, like a lump of dough.
A sweetness comes off me.

lines.zh: 我踩着地面，留下浅浅的印。
lines.en: My tread leaves shallow prints.

lines.zh: 我是蛋糕和灵魂沙拼出来的。
lines.en: I'm cake and soul sand put together.

lines.zh: 我的四蹄一下一下，很稳。
lines.en: Four hooves. Steady rhythm.
I want to run. I don't quite dare.
I go around stones so I don't scuff.

lines.zh: 蛋糕做的蹄子，落地很轻。
lines.en: Cake hooves land very softly.
The air here has a sweet note.

lines.zh: 我走的时候，有人会看着我。
lines.en: People watch when I walk.

lines.zh: 我身上的奶油，有点化了。
lines.en: The frosting on me is softening.
I walk carefully so I don't fall apart.
I circle the house once.
I stop at the door, waiting for a rider.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的糖霜在光下发亮。
lines.en: I stand, frosting glinting.
I'm waiting for someone to ride me.

lines.zh: 我是黏土做的，可我有灵魂。
lines.en: Clay-made, but I have a soul.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，看起来很假。
lines.en: I hold still and look unreal.
My mane is made of cream.
This body hardens in the sun.
No other horses here.
My cream mane sways in the wind.

lines.zh: 有人在旁边看，我习惯了。
lines.en: Someone's watching. I'm used to it.
I rest my weight on my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我身上的甜味，引来了虫。
lines.en: The sweetness draws insects.

lines.zh: 我的糖霜在阳光下有点化。
lines.en: My frosting softens a little in the sun.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，听远处的动静。
lines.en: I raise my head to distant sounds.

lines.zh: 我站着，等一只手放上来。
lines.en: I stand, waiting for a hand.

lines.zh: 我这身颜色，是有人挑的。
lines.en: Someone chose these colours on me.
The wind bends my frosting a little.
Put the saddle on and I'll stand ready.
Is there flour on your hands?

lines.zh: 你身上没有黏土的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell of clay.
My body is made of cake.

lines.zh: 我这么甜，你也想吃我吗？
lines.en: Sweet as I am, do you want to eat me?
I stand and wait for you to come.

lines.zh: 你摸我的时候，我会响一下。
lines.en: When you touch me, I make a small sound.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，鬃毛晃了晃。
lines.en: I tilt my head and my mane sways.
If you want to ride, you must climb up.
I'm only clay. No need to fear.
You stepped back, so I lower my head.
I've waited long. No one's climbed up.

lines.zh: 你用这种眼神看我，很奇怪。
lines.en: That look of yours is strange.
Don't touch the frosting on me.
A little of me crumbled. Not serious.
That cracked the frosting.
I back two steps and hold.

lines.zh: 我身上有一道裂，还能走。
lines.en: There's a crack in me. I can still walk.

lines.zh: 我不太疼，只是不完整了。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt. I'm just less complete.
A corner of frosting breaks off; I can still walk.
I right myself slowly. Hard work.

lines.zh: 我身上的甜味，淡了一点。
lines.en: My sweetness has faded a little.
Stop. I'll come apart.
I lower my head to guard my chest.
Sweet things. I know them.

lines.zh: 你举得再近，我也只是闻。
lines.en: Hold it closer and I still only sniff.
I don't eat. I can only smell.
That smells like me.

lines.zh: 放在地上，我低头看一眼。
lines.en: Set it down and I'll lower my head to look.
I stretch my head over, then back.
I'm sweet enough already.
If you eat it, I'll watch.
I don't eat; I'm sweet enough already.
I'm sweet enough already; keep it.

lines.zh: 你把我撞得抖了一下糖。
lines.en: The bump shakes sugar off me.
A little of me crumbled off.
I back away so I don't rub against you.
That cracked the frosting.
I make way and my tail brushes you.
I'm not sturdy. Don't push.

lines.zh: 撞完我看了看身上，还好。
lines.en: Afterward I check myself. All right.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的蹄子印歪了。
lines.en: That skewed my hoofprint.
You've got a bit of cream on you.
I back two steps and hold.
Two clay horses standing together.

lines.zh: 蛋糕做的马，靠在一起会粘。
lines.en: Cake horses stick when they lean together.

lines.zh: 它身上的糖霜，比我的厚。
lines.en: Its frosting is thicker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，糖霜挨着。
lines.en: We stand side by side, frosting touching frosting.

lines.zh: 风把我们的鬃毛吹到一起。
lines.en: The wind blows our manes together.
This needs no audience.
At dark we go back inside.

lines.zh: 黏土和灵魂沙，也会这样。
lines.en: Clay and soul sand can do this too.

lines.zh: 它走了，我在原地站了一会儿。
lines.en: It leaves. I stand a while longer.
The sweetness stays.
I nudge it with my muzzle — no interest.
Not edible. I set it down.
I sniff. Sweet.
I can't hold small things.

lines.zh: 我把它推到一边，让开路。
lines.en: I nudge it aside to clear the path.

lines.zh: 这东西沾在我蹄子上了。
lines.en: This stuck to my hoof.
I shake my leg and it falls.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，糖霜蹭掉了点。
lines.en: Carrying it, I rub off a little frosting.
I'll keep this. Someone may want it.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看，不感兴趣。
lines.en: I lower my head and look. Not interested.
Someone's climbing up. I hold still.
I plant all four legs.

lines.zh: 我低下头，示意可以上来。
lines.en: I lower my head as a sign to mount.
I know this ground.

lines.zh: 我是蛋糕和灵魂沙捏的马。
lines.en: I am a horse shaped of cake and soul sand.

lines.zh: 我的重量，撑得住一个人。
lines.en: My weight carries one person.
I know the moment you come near.
I square myself up.
Wherever you need, I'll carry you.

lines.zh: 我蹄子在地上刨了两下。
lines.en: My hoof paws the ground twice.
I can take this stretch.
I raise my head and wait.
I stand still. Unmoved.
Icing drips, and I keep walking.
Wherever you go, I'm beside you.
I keep pace with your steps.

lines.zh: 我身上的糖霜，一直在滴。
lines.en: My frosting keeps dripping.

lines.zh: 我是蛋糕做的马，别咬我。
lines.en: I am a cake horse. Do not bite me.

lines.zh: 我踩着糖霜，跟在你后面。
lines.en: Leaving frosting prints, I follow behind you.

lines.zh: 我抬脚的时候，会先看你。
lines.en: When I lift a foot, I check you first.
I've walked this way.
Pull the reins and I understand.
I shift aside a little.
I keep straight. No wandering.
Looking for something? I'll carry you.
I kick out with a hoof.

lines.zh: 我用头撞过去，糖霜掉了。
lines.en: I butt forward and frosting falls.
I'm no fighter. Only good at dodging.
I back off. No more.
You've got cream on you now.
I kick once and sugar crumbs fly.
I put my whole body into it.
Afterward I breathe once.
Don't come again. I don't want to fight.

lines.zh: 踢完我退了半步，怕散架。
lines.en: After the kick I step back, afraid of falling apart.

lines.zh: 我从灵魂沙里站起来，身上还是甜的。
lines.en: I rise out of the soul sand. Still sweet.

lines.zh: 我先看了看自己的身体，很新。
lines.en: I look over myself. Very new.
More ground here than I expected.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩鬃毛，奶油差点掉。
lines.en: I shake my mane. The cream nearly falls.
First thing, I look for a house.

lines.zh: 我身上有灵魂沙的味道。
lines.en: I smell of soul sand.
Someone made me. I wait for them.
I stand steady on all four legs.
No one rides me here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走上两步，试试自己。
lines.en: I take two steps to test myself.
The sun makes me a bit soft.

lines.zh: 我这身颜色，是特意配的。
lines.en: These colours were chosen for me.

lines.zh: 我看了看远处，没有别的马。
lines.en: I look around. No other horses.
I lower my head and sniff the ground.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙在底下，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Soul sand beneath. I can feel it.
I'm ready. Who's climbing up?
Fire melts the frosting.

lines.zh: 我从高处落地，腿断了一条。
lines.en: I land from a height and a leg breaks.
Water soaks in and I start to slough.
The blast breaks me into pieces.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进来，卡在黏土里。
lines.en: Something's stuck in the clay.
Light binds me and my legs won't lift.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我越来越干。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet I dry out.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的形状都散了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my shape loosens.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No ground in the void; I just keep falling.
